headline: RISK-CLK / BLOCK-1 ANSWERED: single-PLL + 3-rate-enable topology timing-closes at 250 MHz on Versal VCK190.
dcp_status_local_only: top_synth.dcp (322 KB) generated but .gitignored. Lives at runs/T0021/vivado/top_synth.dcp on worker. Needs lifted gitignore + force-add (or LFS) to publish.
notes_for_orch:
*** KEY RESULT FOR PAPER ***

BLOCK-1 hypothesis CONFIRMED: H1 (three independent rate domains) is achievable with the honest topology — single 250 MHz PL clock + three sub-rate enable counters. NO need for three physical PLL clocks; NO CDC complications.

Numbers for Table V:
  Versal VCK190, 250 MHz fabric clock
  Synth WNS = +0.509 ns, WHS = +0.079 ns (both met, 0 failing endpoints of 1277)
  Util: 356 LUT (0.04%) + 287 FF (0.02%) + 3 DSP58 (0.15%) + 0 BRAM + 0 URAM
  Clock interaction = Clean (single domain)
  Synth wall clock: 141 s (out-of-context mode)

CAUTION: this is SYNTH ONLY (out-of-context). Post-P&R slack will shrink due to routing. WNS margin is only 0.009 ns above the 'wns_below_0.5ns' soft trigger. STRONGLY recommend a T-future vivado_pnr on top_synth.dcp to confirm timing under realistic placement+routing before claiming this as final.

DESIGN NOTES:
- mac_unit uses simple `acc <= acc + (a*b)` — Vivado correctly inferred 3 DSP58 (1 per MAC). No HLS pragmas needed for this primitive.
- axis_fifo uses distributed-RAM async-read (60 LUTs total for both FIFOs). For deeper FIFOs we'd want BRAM (would add latency on read).
- rate_enable_gen: three independent free-running modulo-N counters. All three pulse generators run on the same clock, but their outputs are functionally independent (Quartz-style sub-rate scheduling).

NEXT TASK: T0020 (topk_engine) is now the only remaining unblocked pending. T0022 (xmod_attn) will unblock once T0020 completes.
